reviews.title: EXCELLENT ★★★★★
reviews.text:
I absolutely LOVE Share Aura! 🤍✨ The app’s features are amazing, everything feels so thoughtfully designed, and the aesthetic is honestly one of my favorite things about it. It’s beautiful, motivating, fun, and has such a unique vibe.

And the latest social update has completely changed the app for me—in the BEST way! 🥹It genuinely feels like a community made for athletes and people who are passionate about running, training, and fitness. Seeing people work out every day, share their runs, post their progress. I love opening the app and seeing everyone putting in the work. It feels like a little community of people who actually GET IT. 🏃‍♀️💪🏻🤍

Honestly, I can already see this app going VIRAL and becoming something really big in the running and workout/fitness world. The potential is huge, especially with the social side of the app. I genuinely think you’re building something special.

One little wish from an early supporter: if you ever introduce paid features in the future (hopefully not 😭), please consider the first 50K people who believed in Share Aura from the beginning. It would be amazing if those first 50K users could get permanent free access to their accounts, or at least some kind of verified early-supporter status. 🥹🤍 We believed in the app before it became huge, and it would be such a beautiful way to appreciate the people who were there from day one.

LOVE LOVE LOVE what you’re doing. Keep growing, keep innovating, and please never lose the community feeling that makes Share Aura so special. 🫶🏻✨

reviews.title: Every Endurance Athlete Should Have This App
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Share Aura for a while now and it’s easily become one of my favorite running apps. I’m someone who tracks basically everything between running, cycling, workouts, races, and all the data that comes along with training, and Share Aura makes it incredibly easy to turn all of that into something I actually want to share.

Instead of posting the same boring activity screenshot every day, I can take my training data and make something that looks genuinely good in about 30 seconds. There are a ton of different templates and ways to customize everything, but the app still feels really simple and intuitive to use. I probably use it more than any other app when I’m posting my training to social media now.

The other thing I really appreciate is how much the app has continued to improve. New features and templates are constantly being added, and you can tell the team actually listens to the people using it and cares about making the product better.

If you run, ride, race, or just like sharing your training, it’s absolutely worth having on your phone. I’ve gotten a ton of use out of it already and I’m really excited to see what they build next. Easy 5 stars.
